desc: The Beretta PX4 Storm Compact Carry 2 represents a culmination of two decades of dedication to innovation and excellence. Engineered and developed in close collaboration with Langdon Tactical Technology, this model received enhancements including the installation of a D Hammer spring that elevates trigger control to new levels, a Type-G De-Cocker tailored for carry-style use. Features a Talon Grip offers superior texture; bobbed conceal carry hammer; heavy contour profile rotating barrel action not only guarantees durability and precision but also significantly minimizes recoil; oversized mag release; improved DA trigger.
